title: Configurations in the run state
statement: Given a finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet, a Boolean input list $x$, and a configuration $c$ for the auxiliary machine with state set built from the states of $M$, say that $c$ has entered a run state when its state is $(q,b)$ for some state $q$ of $M$ and some Boolean tag $b$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet
A configuration $c$ of the auxiliary machine on input $x$
